content: {"episode_id":"ep-05096","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-50","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was ordered for a patient presenting with intermittent palpitations (R00.2) and episodes of dizziness (R42) that are concerning for arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). Continuous rhythm monitoring is required to capture rhythm data and correlate these symptomatic events with potential cardiac dysrhythmias, which intermittent symptoms make otherwise difficult to document. The clinical indication note supports that this service was medically necessary for this patient, and we request reconsideration of the CO-50 denial."}
